name: Simon's City
description: Simon's City is a Chicago greaser gang that originated circa 1952 around Simons Park, located at Drake and Wabansia in the Humboldt Park neighborhood. One of the city's older predominantly white youth gangs, it later spawned the Simon City Royals (founded circa 1968–1969) but continued operating as a separate entity in different parts of Chicago for decades.

sources.title: Chicago's Simon City Royals - Simon City Royal Nation
